source.defect: R10 final gate checks dev/inode/size/mtime_ns but not bytes. An uncooperative writer can mutate the same inode in place and restore mtime; metadata remains identical while the current source part differs from the hash-verified original bytes.
source.fix: Save first-pass SHA256 of each source part and re-open/re-hash all three original paths after the complete ZIP member scan; verify pre-open, descriptor and post-read identities and final SHA256, fail-closed on drift.
source.limitations: No filesystem-level immutable snapshot; a foreign writer can race AFTER the final gate. This does not verify physical 729 source files without the original ZIP bytes.
